description:
Dwarf Hybrid Hibiscus is a compact-growing hibiscus variety known for its large, vibrant flowers and beautiful range of colours. These plants are grown and cared for in our own nursery and supplied as healthy young plants in net pots.

The combo includes a colourful mix of approximately 7–8 shades. Its naturally dwarf and bushy growth makes it a great choice for pots, balconies, terraces and home gardens.

Care Tips:
• Keep in a bright location with good sunlight.
• Water regularly, but avoid waterlogging.
• Transplant from the net pot into a larger pot or grow bag as the plant develops.
• Use well-draining, nutrient-rich potting media.
• Regular feeding and light pruning encourage healthy, bushy growth and flowering.
